text: Sarah Bailey [moves to Los Angeles with her father and stepmother|trigger|making a new home] and falls in with [three outcast girls rumoured to be witches|who_suffers|outcasts and the marginalised], who need a fourth to complete their coven. Calling on Manon, they cast their spells: love for Sarah from the boy who lied about her, healed burn scars for Bonnie, a curse on Rochelle's racist bully, and power for Nancy. [Every spell comes back twisted|rules|everything has a price], and after [Nancy is struck by lightning during the Invocation of the Spirit|images|weather, sky and darkness], the coven turns on Sarah.
